name: AIRS-Bench
intro: AIRS-Bench 用 20 项任务评测科研 Agent 的端到端机器学习研究能力。这些任务从约 100 个候选中筛出，来自 17 篇论文和 16 个数据集，覆盖 7 类问题；Agent 在隐藏测试标签、无基线代码、24 小时单张 H200 的条件下完成开发、训练、验证与预测。
build_method: PapersWithCode与论文任务筛选、人工SOTA核验、任务脚本封装
metric: 平均归一化分数、有效提交率、Elo评级
eval_feature: 端到端科研、隐藏测试标签、跨Scaffold评测
intro_en: AIRS-Bench evaluates end-to-end machine-learning research agents on 20 tasks down-selected from roughly 100 candidates. The final suite comes from 17 papers and 16 datasets across seven categories; agents develop, train, validate, and predict with hidden test labels, no baseline code, and a 24-hour single-H200 budget.
metric_en: Average normalized score, valid submission rate, and Elo rating
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.06855 Sections 2-4 and the official facebookresearch/airs-bench repository. The diagram preserves PapersWithCode/SOTA sourcing, 2020-2025 preference, data and split eligibility, manual metric/split/SOTA verification, the approximately 100-task pool from approximately 85 papers and datasets, fidelity-based selection of 20 tasks across seven categories, the 17-paper/16-dataset boundary, all five task-definition file roles, hidden test labels and no-baseline-code setting, AIRA-dojo/MLGym execution for 24 hours on one H200, task-specific raw scoring, φ(s)=−log10|s−optimal| normalization with worst observed run 0 and literature SOTA 1, and average normalized score, valid submission rate, and Elo reporting.
